name: Focus Timer
shortDescription: A minimalist focus timer with customizable durations, preset intervals, and audio completion cues.
description: A productivity timer app designed for focused work sessions. Features customizable durations from 1-120 minutes, quick preset buttons (5, 15, 25, 45, 60, 90 minutes), pause/resume functionality, and audio alerts on completion. Built with a minimalist interface and full theme support.

generation.notes: Focus timer with customizable durations, preset buttons, pause/resume, audio cues, responsive design, theme support, keyboard/touch accessibility. Standard template followed with real-time logging throughout pipeline.
